- [EVENT] The user expressed interest in the Turks and Caicos Islands and requested more information about diving conditions and the best time to visit.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided information about diving conditions in the Turks and Caicos Islands, including:
  - Water temperature ranges from 78°F (25°C) in winter to 84°F (29°C) in summer.
  - Visibility averages 100-150 feet (30-45 meters), sometimes up to 200 feet (60 meters).
  - Currents are generally mild, suitable for divers of all levels.
  - Dive sites range from shallow reefs to deep walls and wrecks, with maximum depths of around 100-150 feet (30-45 meters).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended the best time to visit as December to April, noting it is cooler and drier with fewer hurricanes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that the peak season is December to March and the off-season is May to November, with a higher chance of hurricanes during June to November.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant listed top dive sites in the Turks and Caicos Islands, including:
  - The Wall
  - Northwest Point
  - The Crack
  - The Library
  - Wreck dives like the HMS Endymion and SS Sapona.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided safety tips for diving in TCI, including choosing certified operators and diving with a buddy.
